text:
emma-chen: Hey all — I'll be in Tokyo for ~90 days (2025-05-10 to 2025-07-08). Quick Qs: is the $150 WFH allowance prorated? Can I claim a travel hotspot month? Any ADP/homebase changes?

people-ops: Hi @emma-chen — short answers: stipend prorated by days abroad in a calendar month; travel hotspot reimbursed as a one-off with receipts (expense code travel-internet); keep homebase as US while temporary. Please file dates in the Travel & Remote Log and CC payroll.

payroll-desk: Thanks — once logged well mark payroll. No ADP homebase changes for temporary stays. If stay >120 days well reassess withholding/state nexus. Proration appears on next paystub after logging.

benefits-team: US medical covers emergency overseas only; routine care and prescriptions usually not covered. Recommend short-term international plan if you expect non-emergency care. We can draft a benefits confirmation for visas/landlords.

it-support: For 2FA, prefer app-based auth or hardware key — SMS from US numbers can fail. Test VPN from a non-US IP before leaving. Keep MFA device and bring travel adapter.

legal-bot: FYI: under 183 days/short stays generally low PE risk, but local immigration/employment rules vary. If youll work physically in Japan beyond 90 days or take local gigs contact Legal early.

emma-chen: Filing the travel log now. Thanks everyone — DMing for the visa/benefits letter.

people-ops: Quick checklist for you: 1) Submit Travel & Remote Log link 2) Keep US homebase in ADP 3) Save receipts for hotspot/equipment 4) Consider travel health insurance 5) Test VPN & 2FA
